attempted_claim: Let A=S(E,tau) be a four-dimensional Sklyanin algebra over algebraically closed k of characteristic 0 with tau of exact order 6, hence PI, and let A^{G,mu} be its Davies Klein-four cocycle twist by G=V4 acting by graded automorphisms with nontrivial 2-cocycle mu, which has 20 point modules and infinitely many fat points of multiplicity 2. Prove or disprove that A^{G,mu} is module-finite over its center Z_tw with the same PI-degree as A and that its Azumaya locus equals the smooth locus of MaxSpec Z_tw. A complete answer gives the center presentation and rank, the PI-degree, the singular locus, and either a proof of coincidence or an explicit witness central character with smooth/singular and Azumaya/non-Azumaya certificates plus the dimensions of simples above it, showing twist-induced degeneracy or its absence.
decisive_failure: No auditable center presentation, rank, PI-degree, singular locus, or Azumaya certificate could be established: exact order-6 parameters, even-order center relations, explicit twisted presentation, and representation data were unavailable locally and controlled retrieval failed, so the target remains unresolved within this pass.
